Mask subject identifiers in a census

Source: R/census.R
mask_ids.Rd

Replaces subject identifiers in the labels of the leave-one-subject-out and deletion-search rows with sequence numbers (S001, S002, ...) in the order of the spec's subject levels, so that a census, report or page can leave the organisation without participant identifiers. The mapping is returned as attr(, "id_map").

Usage

mask_ids(census, spec)

Arguments

census

A stress_census (or stress_rows).

spec

The stress_spec() the census was built from.

Value

The same object with masked labels.

Examples

small <- mmrm::fev_data[mmrm::fev_data$USUBJID %in% paste0("PT", 1:40), ]
spec <- stress_spec(small, "FEV1", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "ARMCD", "PBO", covariates = ~ FEV1_BL,
                    covariance = "cs", method = "Satterthwaite", vcov = "Asymptotic")
cen <- stress_census(spec, stress_loo(spec))
head(mask_ids(cen, spec)$label)
#> [1] "S001" "S002" "S003" "S004" "S005" "S006"
